about.title: Hi, I'm oF
about.subtitle: Full-Stack Development | Machine Learning Research
about.content:
I hold a master’s degree in Information Management and have over one year of professional full-stack development experience. I have worked on manufacturing dashboards, e-paper device management, IoT, and fall detection systems, covering front-end and back-end development, databases, and hardware–software integration.
My research focuses on recommender systems, including knowledge graphs, graph neural networks, sentiment and semantic analysis, and language model applications. My hands-on experience includes data processing, model training, experiment replication, and validation.

items.title: Knowledge Graph–Based Recommendation Method
items.description: A temporal knowledge graph models users’ changing preferences, which are combined with sentiment and semantic information from reviews and product knowledge graph features. Multi-head attention and a rating model then produce Top-K product recommendations.

items.title: Point-of-Interest Recommendation Research
items.description: Contributed to research on graph neural networks and sentiment and semantic analysis. Responsibilities included reproducing experiments, adjusting model evaluation methods, checking data, and running ablation studies.

items.title: Fall Detection System
items.description: The system uses human pose estimation and temporal models to distinguish among normal, loss-of-balance, and fall states. It also integrates live video, event notifications, and environmental sensing.

highlights: Contributed to e-paper device management and IoT system development.
Developed front-end and back-end features and integrated databases with device communication.
Contributed to manufacturing dashboards and management system development.
Developed system features, back-end APIs, and analytics reports, and handled database integration.

items.topic: A Knowledge Graph–Based Recommendation Method Integrating Users’ Dynamic Preferences and Sentiment and Semantic Features
items.description: Studied a personalized product recommendation method that integrates users’ changing preferences, sentiment and semantic information from reviews, and product knowledge graph features.

items.degree: Department of Information and Communication Engineering | B.S.
items.description: Combined human pose estimation, temporal analysis, real-time monitoring, and IoT technology to build a fall detection system. The project received an Honorable Mention in the Department of Information and Communication Engineering’s 2023 Practical Project Competition.

diagram.caption: A simplified overview of the research method. User and product data go through separate feature learning and fusion stages, followed by feature concatenation, rating prediction, and recommendation. Select or focus a node for details.
diagram.label: Knowledge graph–based recommendation method: user and product features are learned and fused separately, then concatenated to predict ratings and generate Top-K recommendations.
diagram.pipelineLabel: Feature concatenation, rating prediction and recommendation
diagram.reviewNote: The same set of reviews is grouped separately by user and product. Connecting lines show the two features entering the fusion stage together.

userGraph.title: Temporal graph feature learning
userGraph.subtitle: Purchase history → Dynamic user preferences
userGraph.description: A temporal knowledge graph is built from purchase history, and a temporal graph neural network learns how user preferences change over time.

userReviews.title: User review semantics
userReviews.subtitle: Semantic extraction · Multi-head attention aggregation
userReviews.description: Reviews are grouped by user. A pretrained language model extracts sentiment and semantic information, which multi-head attention aggregates into user sentiment and semantic features.

userFusion.title: User feature fusion
userFusion.subtitle: Multi-head attention → User features
userFusion.description: Multi-head attention fuses dynamic preferences with sentiment and semantic features from user reviews to produce a user feature vector.

productGraph.title: Product graph feature learning
productGraph.subtitle: Product knowledge graph → Product structural features
productGraph.description: A product knowledge graph is built from product attributes and interaction data. A graph convolutional network then aggregates neighboring nodes into structural product features.

productReviews.title: Product review semantics
productReviews.subtitle: Semantic extraction · Multi-head attention aggregation
productReviews.description: Reviews are grouped by product. A pretrained language model extracts sentiment and semantic information, which multi-head attention aggregates into product sentiment and semantic features.

productFusion.title: Product feature fusion
productFusion.subtitle: Multi-head attention → Product features
productFusion.description: Multi-head attention fuses product structural features with sentiment and semantic features from product reviews to produce a product feature vector.

concatenate.title: User and product feature concatenation
concatenate.subtitle: User features · Product features
concatenate.description: The fused user and product feature vectors are concatenated as input to the rating model.

score.title: Rating prediction (MLP)
score.subtitle: Predict ratings from concatenated features
score.description: An MLP takes the concatenated user and product features, predicts the user’s rating for each candidate product, and provides the score used for ranking.

ranking.title: Top-K recommendations
ranking.subtitle: Rank by predicted scores
ranking.description: Candidate products are ranked by predicted rating, and the K highest-scoring products form the recommendation list.
